------------------------
----EXTERNAL TABLE
------------------------

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.retail
(
    Transaction_ID      VARCHAR(50),
    [Date]              DATETIME2,      -- IMPORTANT
    Customer_Name       VARCHAR(100),
    Product             VARCHAR(100),
    Total_Items         INT,
    Total_Cost          DECIMAL(10,2),
    Payment_Method      VARCHAR(50),
    City                VARCHAR(50),
    Store_Type          VARCHAR(50),
    Discount_Applied    VARCHAR(10),
    Customer_Category   VARCHAR(50),
    Season              VARCHAR(20),
    Promotion           VARCHAR(50),
    [Year]              INT,
    [Month]             INT,
    DataKey             INT,
    [Day]               INT,
    Cost_per_Item       DECIMAL(10,2)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = '2/',              -- folder inside container
    DATA_SOURCE = silver_source,        -- your external data source
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET
);



SELECT * from silver.retail;
